full_page.content:
c. 1900
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 9
Pg. 20 "Reason, as the mistress of the little kingdom within each one of us, should call the will to frequent account, and the other faculties of the soul & senses of the body - as the stuart & other ser- vants are called, that the master may know how his business stands, i.e. his profits & losses - & to see that each one of his house hold receives enough and nothing superfluous or extravagant. S. Chrysostum
8/31/1900 Indignant remark & consolation when on Sunday after, I acknowledged my fault.
Consider the contrast between the biogra- phies of the two saintly friends Athanatius & Basilius (who never saw each other on Earth) the former the champion of the Second Person of the Bl. Trinity; the lat- ter that of the Holy Ghost. -- Fortitude in different colors, etc.
Pg. 21 Letter of Aug. 15th 1900 & circumstances. Novena Dec. 8th 1900 object & letter rec'd. Liberality before Christmas (A.D. 1900) & consoling surprise. Dignatas Eius qui Frater vocatur, quid opporteat esse. B.V.M. Desponsatis. 1/ /1900
Patroc. S. Joseph. Beware of silent criticism - (with L.u.g. about fr. Caj.)
Rosary in bed & bells not heard Dec. 31- Jan. 1, 1902
A.D. 1902 Examination, etc. & quotation from V. Testam. Good-friday night - answer aloud - "no progress in virtue without mor- tification."
